title: Skip API data upgrade in cloud migration

facts.text: Long-running API data upgrades during cloud migration can be skipped per company and resumed after going live.
Cloud migration setup and data replication must be completed before skipping API data upgrade.
Sign in to Business Central online and search for Cloud Migration Management page.
Select Manage API Upgrade action to open the API upgrade overview page.
Select company name, then select Disable API Data Upgrades on the API Data Upgrade List page.
SQL queries can disable API data upgrade for single company or all companies at once.
After going live, run the API data upgrade separately by following the Run API data upgrade process.
